verdict.rationale: Hands-on community reports confirm that Gitea has a built-in repository mirror feature that keeps local copies of external projects. That covers pull mirroring from another Git server. No first-party documentation in the pack describes mirroring, and nothing shows pushing mirrors out to another server or branch-level mirroring. missing for 10: push mirroring to remote servers, branch-level mirror control, first-party mirroring documentation, sync scheduling/configuration details.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can mirror repositories or branches to and from another Git server

citations.quote: Uses the repo mirroring feature to keep local copies of followed projects, which saved them when authors deleted repos.
The mirror feature keeps local copies of followed projects and saved them when authors deleted repos.
